title: ～に際して (〜ni saishite)
shortExplanation: Used to express the moment or the occasion of an action; 'at the time of', 'upon', 'when'.
longExplanation: The ～に際して grammar point describes an action that occurs during a specific event, occasion, or when something takes place. It can be translated into English as 'at the time of', 'upon', 'when', or 'in the event of'. This grammar is used with nouns to describe the context or situation during which an action takes place.

examples.jp: 卒業式に際して、校長先生がスピーチをします。
examples.romaji: Sotsugyoushiki ni saishite, kouchou sensei ga supiichi wo shimasu.
examples.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal gives a speech.

examples.jp: この仕事に際して、責任感が大切です。
examples.romaji: Kono shigoto ni saishite, sekininkan ga taisetsu desu.
examples.en: Responsibility is important when doing this job.

examples.jp: 留学に際して、ビザの手続きが必要です。
examples.romaji: Ryuugaku ni saishite, biza no tetsuzuki ga hitsuyou desu.
examples.en: Visa procedures are necessary when studying abroad.

examples.jp: 結婚式に際して、両親に感謝の気持ちを伝えました。
examples.romaji: Kekkonshiki ni saishite, ryoushin ni kansha no kimochi wo tsutaemashita.
examples.en: At the time of the wedding ceremony, I conveyed my gratitude to my parents.
